📄 Resource Pack Description
Title: Original Anime Cries for Cobblemon (Generations 1-5)
Overview
Bring your Cobblemon world to life with the iconic sounds of the Pokémon anime! This resource pack replaces the default cries with high-quality, Original Anime Cries for the first 649 Pokémon (Generations 1 through 5). Whether it's the roar of a Charizard or the mysterious call of Lugia, every encounter will now feel like a scene straight out of the show.

✨ Key Features
Complete Coverage: Includes all 649 Pokémon from the Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, Sinnoh, and Unova regions.

Anime Authenticity: Every sound is sourced and optimized to match the classic anime experience.

Seamless Integration: Fully compatible with the latest versions of the Cobblemon mod.

High-Quality Audio: All files are converted to professional .ogg format for clear sound without lagging your game.

🛠 Installation Guide
Download the .zip file.

Open Minecraft and go to Options > Resource Packs.

Click Open Pack Folder.

Drag and drop the downloaded file into the folder.

Select the pack in-game and move it to the Selected column.

Enjoy the nostalgia!

⚠️ Technical Note
This pack is a dedicated sound expansion. It is designed specifically to work alongside Cobblemon's folder structure. If you encounter any issues with specific Pokémon sounds, please ensure you are using the correct version of the mod.

Credits & Support
Audio Source: Pokémon Anime Series.

Pack Creator: Developed using custom automation scripts to ensure 100% accuracy in file mapping and JSON configuration.
